frames.seen: A man in black clothing and a white shawl walks toward a stone doorway from an arid landscape alongside companions and pack donkeys.
The man steps further into the shadowed stone doorway as the others follow behind him.
Inside the stone room, the man holds glowing hourglasses with companions standing nearby.
The man in black holds two hourglasses and a cane while facing the camera inside the rustic stone room.
The man holds his hourglasses as another man smiles directly behind him inside the stone room.
The man stands holding hourglasses in the sparsely furnished stone room with wooden chairs and tables.
The man looks forward with a somber expression while holding his hourglasses and walking stick.
The man and his companion smile inside the stone room against a starry night sky visible through the doorway.
The man stands in the room near a woman by a table and a round football resting on the floor.

overall: The world fails to meaningfully transform in response to the spoken poetry, remaining confined to the interior and threshold of a single stone house that merely shifts from day to night. Its biggest weakness is the static, repetitive staging that substitutes literal props like hourglasses and a ball for dynamic visual metamorphosis.
